image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a species of guenon. The monkey is seated on rocky terrain, facing slightly left. It features a distinctive dark face with a lighter brow, a white throat ruff, and an orange-brown belly patch contrasting with greyish-green dorsal fur. Its hands are clasped near its chest, and its long tail curls behind it on the rocks.
